newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Airways sells 18 pct stake to bank.
newsitem.headline: Thai Airways sells 18 pct stake to bank.

text.p: Thai Airways International Plc will sell 18 percent of its outstanding shares to state-owned Government Savings Bank for three billion baht, Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan said on Wednesday.
Amnuay told reporters the equity sale is being made through private placement on a condition that the national carrier would buy back its shares from the bank within five years.
He said Thai Airways is raising a three billion baht fund from the share sale so as to comply with a government policy for it to hold a stake in Don Muang Tollway Co.
The minister said Thai Airways' share sale would not affect its listed price in the Thai stock market as it basically amounts to a temporary share transfer between two state-owned entities.
He said the sale would reduce the Thai finance ministry's stake in Thai Airways to 75 percent from a current 93 percent.
The minister declined to say how many Thai Airways shares would be transferred in two tranches, one priced at their 10-baht par and the other at an undisclosed price.
Thai Airways closed 1.50 baht lower at 38.50 on Wednesday.
